svg.title: F33-6 Cooling terms on the MSC-1 liquid-cooling P&ID fragment
svg.text: ≥ 1.5 × design pressure; TCS 9.0 bar g, 2 h
latch checked before rack flow is adjusted
F33-6 Cooling terms on the MSC-1 liquid-cooling P&ID fragment
FWS 35/45 °C · dry cooler 41 °C at 34 °C dry-bulb, approach 7 K · trim chillers 9 × 2,500 kW per building · TCS 45/55 °C, IST abort 50 °C · ATD = 45 − 35 = 10 K · CHW
• The approach temperature difference (ATD) of the CDU is the TCS supply minus the FWS supply: 45 − 35 = 10 K on MSC-1.
• After flushing, the FWS passes at total viable count below 10,000 cfu/ml (BG 29 Table 4) and the TCS at conductivity of 50 µS/cm or less.
